name: Bedbug Reporting
description:
This dataset contains bedbug infestation filings for residential buildings, most likely in New York City, with 5,000 sampled rows and 21 columns. Each row represents a building's filing for a given reporting period and includes location details such as borough, street address, postcode, latitude and longitude, community board, city council district, census tract, BIN, BBL, and neighborhood tabulation area (NTA). It also records building registration identifiers and the number of dwelling units, along with counts of infested dwelling units, eradicated units, and re-infested units. Filing dates and the start and end dates of each filing period are included, allowing records to be placed in time.

The data can be used to map bedbug infestation hotspots across boroughs and neighborhoods, track eradication and re-infestation rates over time, and compare infestation burden relative to building size. It could support tenant advocacy, landlord compliance monitoring, public health outreach, and resource allocation, as well as analyses linking
